label: Relative order
text: EA.O.A3.1 Relative order. Steno (1669) gave superposition, original horizontality and lateral continuity. Superposition holds for undisturbed, non-overturned layered sequences. Cross-cutting relations are credited to Steno and Hutton. The principle of inclusions is Lyell's. An unconformity is evidence of missing time.

warrant.standard: Stratigraphic context; correlation by two independent methods
